Accomplishment
1. The fourth Taiwanese baseball player to the Major League Baseball, 2005

2. USA Today's "Sports Weekly" was selected as one of the top 100 potential new stars of American professional baseball (30th in the pitcher list, and the only Taiwanese player on the list in 2006)

3. "Best Layout Pitcher of the Year Award" by the Major League Network, 2008

4. The first Taiwan player to hit a home run in the major leagues and be the first Taiwanese player to be selected for the major league star game, 2010

5. Won the Dodge Newcomer of the Year Award (Jim and Dearie Mulvey Award) within the Los Angeles Dodgers. Is the first non-American person to receive this award
